title: Clinical Supply Chain Management and IMP Lifecycle Tracking Landscape
summary: Landscape of clinical supply chain management solutions including CMOs/CDMOs, IRT vendors, and IMP lifecycle tracking capabilities for drug supply in clinical trials.

findings.cmo_cdmo_landscape: Major CDMOs offer integrated IRT, ERP, and forecasting platforms. Key differentiators: cold chain capabilities, just-in-time processing, global reach, regulatory track record. Revenue ranges $700M to multi-billion.
findings.irt_and_imp_tracking: IMP tracking requires: 24/7 shipment visibility, temperature monitoring, dispensation/return tracking, workflow management, and AI/ML demand forecasting. Few vendors offer all capabilities integrated.
findings.econsent_adjacency: eConsent providers offer remote consent with video, e-signature, and patient recruitment portals. Integration between consent and supply systems ensures enrolled patients receive study materials.
findings.integration_with_crm: Supply chain data feeds engagement platforms: supply status informs site communication priorities, stockout risks trigger proactive outreach, supply analytics support feasibility assessments.
findings.market_consolidation: PE firms acquiring IRT and supply chain technology companies, creating integrated platforms mirroring CRM space consolidation.

source: Competitive landscape assessments of clinical supply chain management, IMP tracking, and eConsent providers
